releaseNotes:
﻿## Updates
- Safer in-app updates: before changing the app, Guest Booking now keeps a last-known-good copy so a failed update can restore the previous working version automatically
- Update success requires a real health check (`/api/health`), not just the server starting
- Pre-update database safety copy remains mandatory; if the new version may have touched the database, rollback restores the pre-update copy safely

## Bookings
- Inquiry confirmation and multi-room booking improvements
- Monthly conference tooltip/notes polish
- Room capacity and availability refinements

## Fixes
- Update recovery no longer races a live updater and incorrectly rolls back a successful install
